'''Ram''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|The "Kriosson" (archive ID: ACL071) is amongst the earliest recorded form of the Aggeloi and the most commonly encountered. It attacks by ramming its victims with its horns.}}

==Overview==
As one of the basic melee [[Aggeloi]], Rams are more of a fodder enemy; Their only attack is a ram at front that deals Physical damage.
